decisions.reason: The project-standard 'CLB' abbreviation preserves the locked-feature state and materially reduces width.
The request-confirmation title is natural and comfortably within the dialog-title budget.
The running-shoes-only condition is clear and already at the normal pill/header budget; dropping 'chạy' would change the item meaning.
The label clearly identifies acquired evaluation points and remains within the broader header/dialog budget; dropping either the point type or acquired state needs more layout evidence.
The direct completed-period wording keeps the distinct opening-period meaning while removing the sentence-like construction.
The compact status keeps the fact that the opening period has ended and avoids the over-wide verbal phrase.
Inside the event screen, 'Sự kiện' is redundant context; the direct ended-state label preserves the operational status with less width.
The compact warning preserves the unclaimed-reward meaning, {0}, the Japanese-style quotes, and the source newline exactly.
The login-reward claim action is semantically clear; dropping either 'nhận' or 'đăng nhập' would depend on screen context not available in the batch.
'Hết kỳ tổng kết' compactly preserves that the tallying period—not the event itself—has ended.
The result-publication label is already within the normal per-line budget and preserves both placeholders and the source newline.
The collection-event title is natural and only marginally above a normal compact header budget; removing the event noun would rely on missing layout context.
The event screen supplies the possessive context; 'Thưởng chung sự kiện' preserves the collective event-reward category with much less width.
Both source lines are naturally translated, preserve the newline exactly, and remain within the per-line budget.
